name: Inrō
description:
Inrō is an Instagram automation platform that helps brands manage stories & posts, automate comments & DMs, and setup an Instagram AI agent. The MCP server gives Claude direct access to your Inrō workspace so it can inspect data, answer questions, and perform actions on your behalf.

With this connector, Claude can:

• Schedule and publish, posts, reels and stories
• Create and edit automation scenarios on comments and DMs
• Manage Instagram conversations and contacts
• Search conversations and customer data
• Organize contacts with folders, tags, and custom properties
• Launch and monitor DM campaigns
• Configure a DM AI agent with knowledge and actions
• Build conversion flows with links, payments, bookings, and surveys
• Access analytics and execution data

Whether you're creating a new Instagram funnel, finding customers who need follow-up, launching a campaign, or debugging an automation, Claude can interact directly with your Inrō account instead of requiring manual clicks.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inrō to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inrō to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.inro.social/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inrō MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inrō lists 18 MCP tools, including agent, batch_tasks, campaign_folders, campaigns, contact_properties, contacts, conversion_links, folders, get_action_types, get_organization_info, get_trigger_types, and media_files.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inrō?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inrō in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Inrō requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inrō is developed by Inrō. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
